records.title: Altgard opens
records.blurb: Extraction and pets unlock. Sealed Dungeons and Strongholds open; tick them in Dungeons & Strongholds.

records.title: Daevanion board
records.blurb: First Daevanion board (Nezekan) opens with "Urgent Pursuit"; first regional quest.

records.title: Ring quest and skills
records.blurb: Spooky Specters for a ring, plus four skill upgrades.

records.title: Legions
records.blurb: Unlock Legions; six quests fill your accessory slots.

records.title: Skill tier: level 8
records.blurb: Quick Slice, Savage Roar and Shadowstrike reach skill level 8.

records.title: Zikel board
records.blurb: Second Daevanion board and a new batch of Sealed Dungeons.

records.title: Stigma slot 1
records.blurb: Stigmas and Expeditions unlock.

records.title: Supply Requests
records.blurb: Hand in spare items for Abyss Points.

records.title: Stigma slot 2
records.blurb: Second stigma goes in.

records.title: Heart Gore 10 and Urugugu Canyon
records.blurb: Heart Gore reaches its point cap; a party Expedition opens.

items.text: Urugugu Canyon [[tip:expedition|Expedition]] (Exploration) opens: needs a party of 2–5 and item level 300.
items.loc: The story quest "Canyon's Secret" (Lv 30) sends you in.

records.title: Daily dungeon and Vaizel board
records.blurb: Daily dungeon unlocks; Vaizel board.

records.title: Stigma slot 3
records.blurb: Third stigma goes in.

records.title: Fire Temple
records.blurb: Third party dungeon opens.

records.title: Stigma slot 4
records.blurb: Full rotation online; the story takes you into the Fire Temple.

records.title: Triniel board
records.blurb: Fourth Daevanion board.

records.title: Level cap
records.blurb: Progression shifts from level to gear score.

records.title: Wings and Ascension
records.blurb: Two story quests around the lake. Don't delay them.

records.title: Enhancement unlocks
records.blurb: Save your stones; only the belt and amulet are always worth it.

records.title: Don't spend yet
records.blurb: The most common early regrets.

records.blurb: Hero quests give most of your XP to 45.
